summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.1 - UI Update ## Introduction to UI Updates Now I will introduce you to the update of the UI-related functions. In the new version of 2025.1, we have optimized and updated the library. ## Connect Shop Enhancements We have added the label page of Connect Shop, which makes it more convenient to purchase and download assets. Additionally, we have synchronized the selection function of the web page, allowing you to find the content you need more quickly. ### Accessing the Library Go to the library and click on Connect Shop. First, let's find a free fabric asset. Double-click, and you can see that the fabric is directly added to the object window. ### Dragging Assets Let's try to drag a free clothing asset directly. You can see that there is also an additional asset search and selection function here. We can choose clothing first and open the selector. You can see that there are options for gender, age, style, and other categories. ### Selecting Assets We can select one of the five asset options based on our requirements. You can also search and input a keyword to look for specific items. You will see that this clothing is directly added to your selection. Note that the selection options corresponding to different asset types are also different. ## Purchasing Paid Assets Now let's try to buy a paid clothing asset. At this time, we need to right-click on the asset. A purchase cart will appear; open it in Connect. Click on the purchase cart to view the assets that have been added. After clicking on purchase, it will automatically jump to the purchase interface. Once the purchase is completed, the assets can be added to our project. You can also check the purchase record at the bottom; your purchased assets will be recorded here and classified. ## Design Optimization We can see that the 2025.1 design optimization makes it easier for us to add assets from Connect to the business city, allowing us to find and use resources more quickly. ## Virtual Model Information Display In the new 2025.1 version, the virtual model information display function has been added to the semi-transparent surface. This allows users to check the relationship between the model and the version while editing. Additionally, the display grid of the virtual model can be added to the bottom separately for more convenient use. ### Viewing Relationships When we are making clothing, we hope to see the relationship between the clothing and the virtual model from all directions. For example, when the virtual model is on a physical surface or a black-and-white surface, we cannot directly check the relationship between the clothing and the virtual model. Some clothing may be blocked by the model. ### Using the Virtual Model Information Display To check the relationship between the clothing and the virtual model, go to the 3D vertical menu, find the virtual model information display, and choose the semi-transparent surface. At this time, you will be able to see the virtual model semi-transparently, allowing you to check the clothing and the model objectively to ensure harmony. ## Display Grid Functionality In the virtual model information display, open the display grid. When using the display grid, while switching the model information display, it can also maintain the grid display state. This helps in visualizing how the virtual model aligns with the clothing. ## User Advantages The CLO 2025.1 version provides users with the advantage of virtual model display, enabling them to check clothing and virtual model information more objectively, leading to a more comfortable experience during the creation process. ## File Import and Export In the previous version, when you import or export a 3D file, you could select the desired option below and save it in the Preview File Manager, allowing you to name the preview. Next time you import or export a file, you only need to select the preset option you saved. ### Importing FBX Files Click on the 3D file, select import, and use the FBX file as an example. Find the FBX file and click open. Adjust the settings below. Click Add, and you will see a preset path here. You can set it yourself. After setting the preset path, you can name it "preset1" and click OK. ### Using Presets for Importing You can now delete this FBX file. When you try to import the FBX again, you will find that the preset has become the selected configuration. Click Add in the preset to create a new preset name, such as "preset2." Now you will see two preset options that you have previously set up. Click to confirm the import. ### Exporting FBX Files The next time you need to export FBX files with the same settings, you can select the settings you previously created. The export file will also be the same. Click to import the file and select the save location to change the export settings below. Click to add the preset path and name. This allows you to select the same settings as before in future exports. ## New Configuration for Import/Export In the new version of CLO, the new configuration is used to import and export files, which can save time and provide a direct path for users. ## 2D Quick Photo Functionality In the new version, the 2D quick photo function has also been updated. A new 2D line option has been added, allowing you to change the color and type of the line. ### Accessing 2D Quick Photo Find the file and open the 2D version of the quick photo. By pressing the button for 2D 1-to-1, the 2D quick photo play window appears. You can see that compared to the previous version, this version allows for a more direct view of the line option and other information. ### Customizing Lines You can change the lines in the line option to point curve lines and holo lines, and you can also change the color of the line. Here, we can see that the base line and the cutout are displayed separately. ### Saving 2D Quick Photo Settings When you have set up the options for the 2D quick photo, you can choose to save it. The quick photo function in the cherry blossom release mode has also been updated, allowing users more freedom to edit the output effect of the 2D version and have more self-determined choices. ## Adjusting Clothing Versions When users adjust the clothing version in the building, it is necessary to ensure that the unit is the same size as the actual clothing. In the new version 2025.1, you can adjust the number of small numbers in the system. Select a line to view; currently, only one small number can be seen. ### Customizing Small Numbers Open the settings and navigate to the user self-definition interface. Find the unit small number, which can be set from 1 to 5 by the user. This allows us to change the number of small numbers to 4. Click for adjustment. ### Final Remarks The information we are going to set up here indicates that there are no issues with the cameo in the original photos. ```
